output_list.reason: The 'distr' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function increases the totalDistributed variable without ensuring it does not exceed the totalSupply, allowing a user to gain tokens out of thin air.

The 'getTokens' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function decreases the totalRemaining variable by a factor of 100000, which can overflow and cause a user to gain tokens out of thin air.
The 'transferFrom' function allows a spender to transfer funds to an arbitrary address, which can be exploited to allow attackers to steal funds from user accounts.
The 'approve' function uses a predictable pattern to generate random values, which can be exploited by attackers to gain unauthorized access.
